messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

message.content:
Hawaii’s climate is remarkably mild all year, so you can enjoy pleasant weather almost any time.  
The “best” months usually depend on what you’re after:

| Goal | Best Months | Why |
|------|-------------|-----|
| **Lowest crowds & best deals** | **April, May, September, October** | These shoulder‑season months see fewer tourists, lower airfare and hotel rates, and still have warm, sunny weather. |
| **Surfing (big‑wave season)** | **November–January** | The winter swells are at their peak, especially on the North Shore. |
| **Family vacation (school holidays)** | **June–August** | Summer is the most popular time, so expect higher prices and larger crowds, but the weather is reliably warm and dry. |
| **Wildlife & whale watching** | **December–February** | Humpback whales migrate along the coast, offering spectacular sightings. |

If you’re looking for a balance of great weather, fewer crowds, and reasonable prices, **late spring (April–May) or early fall (September–October)** are typically the sweet spots.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like more detailed data—such as average monthly temperatures or rainfall—for a specific Hawaiian island!
